items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: A drummer with Major Bowes on the Sunday Morning Capitol Theater Family, Morehouse has played drum specialties several times

ctx.x: I see. This was in the thirties. This is before...

In '38, this was before the war. And he also played I think appeared with Major Bowes on the Capitol. He had the Amateur Hour and then he had on Sundays, the Capitol Theater Hour and Chauncey appeared on that.
